name: Cone Casting with Inscribed Sphere Sampling
definition: A rendering strategy that formulates a pixel as a disc on the image plane and emits a cone from the camera's projection center to sample the volume, avoiding the aliasing artifacts of distance-agnostic ray casting.
summary: Cone casting with inscribed sphere sampling is a volume rendering technique that uses spheres inscribed within cones to provide isotropic pre-filtering, avoiding the aliasing artifacts of distance-agnostic ray casting.
